snippet.title: American Truck Simulator - Iowa Video Trailer
snippet.description:
Get ready to explore & haul a variety of loads through Iowa in American Truck Simulator! Get ready to explore the Hawkeye State as you drive along the iconic I-80 to the capital city of Des Moines and discover charming towns along the Mississippi River.

Iowa for American Truck Simulator releases on July 10th! Add it to your Steam Wishlist today: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3025440/American_Truck_Simulator__Iowa/
